verifications.claim: Filing Form 4868 by the April 15 deadline provides an automatic six-month extension to file federal income tax returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'extensions are available with Internal Revenue Service Form 4868. To qualify for an automatic extension to October 15'; R2: 'filing a tax extension via Form 4868, which pushes the due date to October 15'; R3: 'File Form 4868... request an extension by the filing due date'; R6: 'File Form 4868... request the extension by April 15'; R9: 'File Form 4868... by the April tax filing due date'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Form 4868 filed by April 15 grants automatic extension to October 15 (six months).

verifications.claim: The six-month extension moves the filing deadline from April 15 to October 15.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'automatic extension to October 15'; R2: 'pushes the due date to October 15'; R3: 'until October 15 to file'; R4: 'until October 17'; R5: 'six months to file'; R6: 'until Oct. 15, 2026'; R9: 'until October 15'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently confirm extension shifts federal filing deadline from April 15 to October 15.

verifications.claim: The extension is only for submitting paperwork; any taxes owed must still be paid by April 15 to avoid penalties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Only the filing gets an extension, as tax payments remain due April 15'; R2: 'you still must pay taxes by the original April 15 deadline'; R3: 'the extension is only for filing a return and not for extra time to pay'; R4: 'An extension to file is not an extension to pay'; R6: 'extra time to file, not additional time to pay'; R9: 'The extension is only for filing your return'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources explicitly state extension applies only to filing, not payment, due April 15.

verifications.claim: Electronic payment via IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or Digital Wallet with "Extension" selected as the payment type provides a confirmation number and eliminates the need to file Form 4868.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'make a tax payment online and choose “extension”... automatically submits Form 4868. You won’t need additional forms'; R3: 'Pay online and select extension... confirmation number... no need to file any additional forms'; R4: 'electronic payment with Direct Pay... debit, credit card or digital wallet and select... extension... don't need to file Form 4868'; R6: 'Pay online... Direct Pay... select “extension”... confirmation number... no additional forms'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly describe electronic payments (including specified methods) with 'extension' selection granting extension, confirmation, without Form 4868.

verifications.claim: IRS Free File allows electronic filing of Form 4868 using free tax software regardless of income.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'file Form 4868 via IRS Free File... no income limit for extensions'; R3: 'Use IRS Free File... regardless of income'; R4: 'using IRS Free File... regardless of income'; R6: 'Use IRS Free File... at no cost'; R9: 'Use Free File (no income limit for extensions)'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm IRS Free File for Form 4868/extensions with no income limit.

verifications.claim: Mailing Form 4868 to the IRS postmarked by April 15 is accepted.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'mail Form 4868... postmarked by April 15'; R3: 'File Form 4868... by mail'; R5: 'mail Form 4868 to the IRS... postmarked by... April 15'; R6: 'File Form 4868 by mail'; R9: 'File Form 4868... by mail'
verifications.reasoning: Sources state mailing Form 4868 postmarked by April 15 is valid for extension.

verifications.claim: The extension gives more time to submit the tax return but requires estimating and paying tax liability by April 15 to avoid interest and late payment penalties.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'tax payments remain due April 15'; R2: 'estimate your total liability... send the balance by the original due date'; R3: 'estimate how much tax is owed... pay the balance owed... to avoid penalties and interest'; R4: 'pay taxes by April 18 to avoid penalties and interest'; R5: 'taxes due... by the tax deadline'; R6: 'estimate their total tax liability... pay the remaining balance by the deadline... avoid... penalties and interest'
verifications.reasoning: Sources uniformly require estimation and payment by April 15 to avoid penalties/interest, while extending filing.

verifications.claim: Filing an extension prevents the failure-to-file penalty of 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'failure to file penalty... 5% of the tax owed each month... up to a maximum of 25%'; R2: 'failure-to-file penalty is 5% of your unpaid taxes monthly, up to 25%'; R3: 'until October 15 to file without penalties'; R5: 'penalty for not filing... 5% of the tax due for each month... not... more than 25%'
verifications.reasoning: Sources detail 5%/month up to 25% failure-to-file penalty, avoided by timely extension filing.
